description: HTML template for a TinyMCE table plugin configuration interface, including form elements, tabs, and scripts for table properties.

methods.name: executeOnLoad
methods.description: Initializes the popup when the page loads.

methods.name: displayTab
methods.description: Switches between general and advanced property panels.

methods.name: changedBorder
methods.description: Handles changes to the border property.

methods.name: changedSize
methods.description: Handles changes to size properties like width and height.

methods.name: updateColor
methods.description: Updates color pickers and related properties.

methods.name: insertTable
methods.description: Inserts or updates the table based on form inputs.
